fullPassage: In one of the most famous passages of Being and Nothingness, “The Look,” Jean-Paul Sartre describes the peculiar vulnerability that develops when someone goes from seeing (being a self with a perspective on the world) to being seen (having to confront the perspective of another on one’s self). He illustrates it with the example of someone looking through a keyhole who suddenly finds himself caught by someone watching him. The look of the other is always unnerving, Sartre argues, not only because we momentarily recognize ourselves in it through our imagination of their judgment of us but also because we don’t. We can always step back, challenge our perception of others’ perceptions of ourselves, or explain them away — but we don’t know what these perceptions really are. Others have the distinctive power of making us feel judged in ways we cannot fully control. Social life is all about the fear that accompanies our awareness that we can never fully comprehend social consensus. We can only guess.

questions.passage: In one of the most famous passages of Being and Nothingness, “The Look,” Jean-Paul Sartre describes the peculiar vulnerability that develops when someone goes from seeing (being a self with a perspective on the world) to being seen (having to confront the perspective of another on one’s self). He illustrates it with the example of someone looking through a keyhole who suddenly finds himself caught by someone watching him. The look of the other is always unnerving, Sartre argues, not only because we momentarily recognize ①<u>ourself</u> in it through ②<u>our</u> imagination of their judgment of us but also because we don’t. We can always step back, challenge our perception of others’ ③<u>perceptions</u> of ourselves, or explain them away — but we don’t know what these perceptions really ④<u>are</u>. Others have the distinctive power of making us feel judged in ways we cannot fully control. Social life is all about the fear that accompanies our awareness that we can never fully comprehend social consensus. We can only guess.

det.korean: 타인의 시선(The Look)이 주는 취약성, 불안(unnerving), 통제 불가능한 판단, 사회적 합의 이해 불가에 대한 두려움
det.analysis:
① 타인의 시선이 개인에게 미치는 심리적 불안과 사회적 두려움 — 글의 핵심 내용. vulnerability, unnerving, fear, social consensus 모두 포함 ←정답

③ 사회적 합의 달성 — 원문은 합의를 이해할 수 없다는 것이지 달성이 아님
④ 상상력의 긍정적 역할 — 상상은 불안의 원인이지 긍정적 역할이 아님
det.tip: The Look + vulnerability + unnerving + fear + social consensus = 시선과 사회적 불안

det.korean: 보이는 것의 취약성→통제 불가→사회적 합의 이해 불가의 두려움
